reporting.title: Reporting without sign-in
reporting.what: When this is on, anyone who has the link, or who scans the QR code of a unit, can send a report without signing in: a visitor, a patient, or a member of staff with no account. These reports are always anonymous. They arrive in the incidents list like any other, and the sender gets a follow-up code to read your replies.
reporting.shows: The form shows the names of your facilities, departments, units and incident categories to anyone who opens the link. It does not show any incidents.
reporting.offHelp: While it is off, the link and the QR codes open a page saying that reporting is not available.
reporting.onHelp: Switching it off stops the link and every printed QR code at once. Reports already received are kept, and their follow-up codes keep working.
reporting.linkHelp: For the intranet, an email or a poster. Each facility, department and unit also has its own link and QR code, on its page under “Organization”.
reporting.followUpHelp: Where someone who reported anonymously types their follow-up code to read your replies. It works whether reporting without sign-in is on or off, because staff who sign in can report anonymously too.

deadlines.title: Deadlines for triage and closure
deadlines.what: These numbers set how long your hospital allows itself to triage a new report and to close an incident, by harm level. Both are counted from the moment the report is made. Anything past its time shows as overdue in the incidents list and on the dashboard, and the people responsible for it are notified.
deadlines.applies: A change applies to new reports, and to an incident whose harm level or sentinel flag is changed afterwards: its closure deadline is then worked out again from this table. Other deadlines already set do not move. Hours and days are calendar time, so nights, weekends and holidays count.
deadlines.sentinel: A sentinel event follows the row for a death, whatever its harm level.
deadlines.limits: Hours: a whole number from 1 to 720. Days: a whole number from 1 to 365.
deadlines.invalid: Not saved. Enter whole numbers: from 1 to 720 for the hours, from 1 to 365 for the days.
deadlines.readOnly: Only someone whose role lets them change settings for the whole organization can change these numbers.

permissions.incidents.sign_off: Sign off closures that need a second signature
